scope: Fresh GitHub/GitLab long-tail discovery. Six Atari ST games are distinct targets in one shared repository. Asset and game-data files were not copied; only source URLs are recorded.

projects.title: Buggy Boy Atari ST Decompilation
projects.game: Buggy Boy (Atari ST)
projects.platform: Atari ST/STE Motorola 68000 → reconstructed C and ST/STE program
projects.status: The README reports an end-to-end reconstruction: 91/91 functions verified, 81 test modules, and a playable ST/STE program with sound. Its optional remaster is reported pixel-identical to the verified reconstruction.
projects.summary: Reconstructs shipped Atari ST 68000 code as readable C, verifies it against the original binary, and compiles it back for Atari ST/STE.
projects.strategy: Byte-matching 68000 source reconstruction in C
projects.source_available: Public source/tooling repository; the README says game executables, disk images, game data, and TOS ROM are not included; users bring their own copies.

projects.summary: A static recompilation of the USA PlayStation release to a native Windows x64 build with user-supplied disc data.
projects.strategy: Static MIPS recompilation to x86-64
projects.source_available: Public source and release repository; game code and data are not included; user supplies the original disc.

projects.title: Rival Schools: Evolution Disc PS1 Recompilation
projects.game: Rival Schools: United by Fate – Evolution Disc (PlayStation USA SLUS-00771)
projects.platform: PlayStation MIPS → native Windows/Linux setup package
projects.status: Static recompilation using psxrecomp/recomp-ui. Setup requires the user’s own USA Evolution Disc image and SCPH-1001 BIOS; releases are linked from the README. No full-playthrough claim is made.
projects.summary: A static-recompilation setup kit for the USA Evolution Disc, distinct from the base Rival Schools disc. First-run setup generates and compiles game code locally.
projects.strategy: Static MIPS recompilation with user-owned disc and BIOS setup
projects.source_available: Public source/release repository; game data, retail BIOS, generated game code, and saves are not distributed.

projects.title: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time Xbox Recompilation
projects.game: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time (original Xbox demo and retail)
projects.platform: Xbox executable (XBE) → native Windows static recompilation
projects.status: As of 2026-10-15, the maintainer reports the E3 demo playable through a scripted third-level sequence at 55–60 fps and a retail build reaching the opening scene after intro/menu/profile setup; retail gameplay has not yet been reached.
projects.summary: A static recompilation of the original Xbox demo and retail builds to native Windows, with separate status for the demo and retail executable. The repository contains no game files.
projects.strategy: Static PowerPC-to-C recompilation with Xbox runtime
projects.source_available: Public source repository; user supplies their own disc files; game code and assets are not included.

projects.title: Army of Two: The 40th Day Xbox 360 Recompilation
projects.game: Army of Two: The 40th Day (Xbox 360, Title ID 454108D8)
projects.platform: Xbox 360 PowerPC → native Windows x64
projects.status: Proof of concept. The maintainer reports the opening movies, menus, Shanghai chapter, and an 11-minute Highrise fight running with sound/video; the campaign cannot yet be completed and missing recompiled functions may crash.
projects.summary: A Windows x64 static recompilation based on ReXGlue, with generated code built from the user’s own Xbox 360 `default.xex`.
projects.strategy: Static PowerPC recompilation through ReXGlue
projects.source_available: Public source repository; user supplies and extracts an original legally obtained Xbox 360 disc; no game files are included.

sources.label: Maintainer README: current proof-of-concept state and required user files

projects.title: Final Fantasy Tactics PS1 Native Port Lab
projects.game: Final Fantasy Tactics (PlayStation USA SCUS-94221)
projects.platform: Matching PlayStation C source → native Windows build and OpenGL renderer
projects.status: Work in progress. The README reports the game running through the first battle, world map, and menus; deterministic runs matched the original machine code at each frame, and GPU output was compared across about 54,000 frames. The ending and further fidelity work remain open.
projects.summary: A native PC runtime based on the existing FFT matching decompilation, with PlayStation GPU/SPU/CD services and differential tests against user-supplied original machine code.
projects.strategy: Native platform-layer port from a matching decompilation with machine-code differential oracle
projects.source_available: Public source repository; no game data is included and the user supplies their own disc.
